name: WriteToExcelWorksheet
label: Write to Excel Worksheet
description: Writes a value to a specific cell or range of cells in an Excel worksheet.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object where the value will be written.

fields.name: ValueToWrite
fields.label: Value To Write
fields.description: The value (text or DataTable) to write into the specified cell or range.

fields.name: WriteMode
fields.label: Write Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to determine the target cell(s) for writing.

selectOptions.label: On Specified Cell
selectOptions.description: Writes to a specific cell by column and row.

selectOptions.label: On Currently Active Cell
selectOptions.description: Writes to the currently active cell.

fields.name: ColumnIndex
fields.label: Column Index
fields.description: The index of the column (1 for 'A'). Takes precedence if greater than 0.

fields.name: Row
fields.label: Row
fields.description: The row number where the data should be written.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The name of the named range to write to.

fields.name: PopulateEntireRange
fields.label: Populate Entire Range
fields.description: If true, populates the entire named range with the same value.
